- Initial spectral shaping using geometric amplitude adjustment
- Peak-directed time domain optimization with improved subgradient calculation
- L-BFGS refinement with adaptive smoothing parameter initialization

- Better handling of convolution byproducts through gradient compression
- Polynomial smoothing of the L-maximum term for improved optimization convergence
- Time-budget allocation between optimization stages to prevent resource exhaustion
